 When Boston P.D. discovers a baby abandoned in a food delivery robot, Danny’s anger causes him to slip back into his old rule-breaking ways. Also, Sarah faces a difficult decision when her estranged mother, Gwen (Marg Helgenberger), reenters her life, and Sean and Jonah search for a fellow officer who went AWOL, on the CBS Original series BOSTON BLUE, Friday, Nov. 13  (10:00-11:00 PM, ET/PT) on the CBS Television Network, and streaming live on Paramount+ (Premium) and next day.

 Description 
 Jamie Reagan’s visit to Boston takes an unexpected turn when he and Danny are drawn into a diamond heist linked to a violent family feud, forcing the brothers to confront lingering tensions of their own. Meanwhile, Mae faces a difficult case after swatting results in a man’s death, Lena investigates a series of suspicious deaths linked to one of Reverend Peters’ parishioners and Sarah and Seth encounter an unexpected hurdle while planning their wedding, on the CBS Original series BOSTON BLUE, Friday, Nov. 6  (10:00-11:00 PM, ET/PT) on the CBS Television Network, and streaming live on Paramount+ (Premium) and next day.
